body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain. It starts at Av. de la Cornisa, 2, Puerto Rico.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Angry Birds activity park is what every kid dreams of when they think of a fun park! There are more than 20 attractions, and each is better than the last. From trampolines and ziplines that let you crash into your own constructions to scooter ramps and a three-meter-tall tower that'll make you wish you had wings when you jump from it!
>
> There are multipurpose sports courts, interactive sports challenges, a parkour practice area, and even F1 pedal cars. On top of all of that, there’s also free mini-golf and a splash zone.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €14.62. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 146 ratings and 87 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
